rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a 3AA blastocyst and appropriately covers expansion, ICM, TE, and zona thinning, but it relies somewhat on the provided grade and includes positional detail that may not be clearly verifiable from the image alone.

Integrates age, BMI, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and ovarian response with embryo quality well, though it overstates the significance of the 7/7 MII rate and cannot address AMH due to missing data.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to age, morphology, and prior miscarriage; minor overinterpretation of some favorable factors prevents a perfect score.

SET recommendation and general counseling are guideline-concordant, but suggesting aspirin/heparin based only on miscarriage history and broadly recommending PGT-A after one failed transfer/miscarriage is somewhat more aggressive than standard evidence-based guidance.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, and contingency planning after repeat loss, though some recommendations would benefit from more precise criteria for when to escalate testing or adjunctive therapy.
